announcements.headline: Notification Annual Results Announcement FY2026
announcements.insight: Tharisa announces its FY2026 annual results. This follows recent strategic moves including a Namibia listing and new offtake agreements.

announcements.headline: Listing on the Namibia Securities Exchange
announcements.insight: Tharisa lists on the Namibia Securities Exchange. This follows its migration to SETS in September and recent commercial agreements.

announcements.headline: Tharisa secures early renewable energy from Etana
announcements.insight: Tharisa secures early renewable energy from Etana. This follows recent bond issuance and concentrate offtake agreements, suggesting ongoing operational and financial developments.

announcements.headline: PGM concentrate offtake agreement with Valterra
announcements.insight: Tharisa has secured a PGM concentrate offtake agreement with Valterra. This commercial development follows recent bond issuance and listing migration.

announcements.headline: Migration to the Electronic Trading Service (SETS)
announcements.insight: Tharisa shares migrate to SETS. This follows recent bond issuance and director shareholding updates.

announcements.headline: Bond proceeds placed in Escrow - CP satisfied
announcements.insight: Following the September bond issue, proceeds are now in escrow as a condition precedent is satisfied. This advances the financing process initiated earlier this year.

announcements.headline: Investor Meetings and Senior Secured Bond Issue
announcements.insight: Tharisa raises capital via a senior secured bond issue, following its earlier ZAR750m facility and ADR launch. This expands funding options for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: Director shareholding changes are routine governance updates. Shareholders should monitor future filings for any significant shifts in insider ownership levels.

announcements.headline: Karo signs Special Mining Lease Agreement
announcements.insight: Karo secures a Special Mining Lease Agreement. This follows the Q3 2026 production report and recent financing, indicating continued operational development.

announcements.headline: Production Report Q3 2026 ended 30 June 2026
announcements.insight: Tharisa reports Q3 production. This follows its June ADR launch and ZAR750m facility.

announcements.headline: Nedbank ZAR750 million Asset Finance Facility
announcements.insight: Tharisa secures a ZAR750 million asset finance facility from Nedbank. This follows the launch of its Level 1 ADR programme in June 2026.

announcements.headline: Tharisa launches Level 1 ADR Programme
announcements.insight: Tharisa launches a Level 1 ADR Programme. This may enhance liquidity for UK-listed shares but offers limited immediate value without further details.
